generalComment.value:
The owner of this EPD shall be liable for the underlying information and evidence. The programme operator Kiwa-Ecobility Experts shall not be liable with respect to manufacturer data, life cycle assessment data and evidence. 
This is a Cradle to gate with options, modules C1-C4 and module D EPD.

description.value: Generic data from the ecoinvent v.3.6 database (system model allocation, cut-off) were used for primary products, raw materials and supplies as well as energy generation and disposal processes. Purchased parts for which no generic data was available were accounted for on the basis of the material composition. The highest proportion of environmental impacts is caused by the use phase, which is, however, based on assumptions about the daily usage time. For this reason, an average period of use was selected. However, even with a minimum daily usage time, the contribution of the usage phase would dominate. Use-Stage: To balance the usage phase, the scenario for an active product was selected in which the sensor consumes 80% of the load hours in standby mode with a consumption of 0.4 W. The sensor is active 20% of the time and consumes 1.1 W. The detector is never switched off. The presence detector consumes 47.3 kWh over a period of 10 years. The currently used Scenario is representative for one of the most likely scenario alternatives Transport to construction site: The customers of Steinel are B2B as well as B2C customers. This means that either partners with their own storage space or customers can be supplied directly. An average distance of 500 km was used to calculate the transport to the customer. Waste Scenario: For disposal purposes, it is assumed that the presence detector are recycled as electronic waste. The cut-off approach is used for recycling, whereby the secondary use of the material is cut off. Excluded processes are: Long-term emissions The manufacture of equipment used in production, buildings or any other capital goods; The transport of personnel to the plant; The transportation of personnel within the plant; Research and development activities.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
The IR Quattro is an infrared presence detector. The IR QUATTRO HD DALIPLUS was used as the reference product for this representative EPD due to similar components and weights.
The presence detectors are produced at three locations and then stored in Herzebrock Clarholz and delivered to customers. All locations are certified in accordance with the environmental management standard 14001:2015. The Injection molded parts are produced at the Leipzig-Mölkau site. The resulting production waste, which averages 5%, can normally be reground and reused. However, we consider the 5% to be production waste in our calculation. The Printed circuit boards are produced in Einsiedeln. Here, the PCBs are fitted with electronic components using THT and SMD processes at the Swiss site in Einsiedeln. The preproducts manufactured in Mölkau and Einsiedeln are assembled and packaged in Curtea de Arges together with other purchased preproducts and then transported to the dispatch warehouse in Herzebrock-Clarholz. Steinel determined the electricity, gas, oil and water consumption per product for the sites by dividing the annual consumption by the production figures. The activity data collected by the company related to the year 2023.

Der IR Quattro ist ein Infrarot-Präsenzmelder. Als Referenzprodukt für diese repräsentative EPD wurde der IR QUATTRO HD DALIPLUS verwendet, da er ähnliche Komponenten und Gewichte aufweist.


Die Präsenzmelder werden an drei Standorten produziert, anschließend in Herzebrock-Clarholz gelagert und an Kunden ausgeliefert. Alle Standorte sind gemäß der Umweltmanagementnorm ISO 14001:2015 zertifiziert. 

Die Spritzgussteile werden am Standort Leipzig-Mölkau gefertigt. Das dabei entstehende Produktionsabfallaufkommen, das im Durchschnitt 5 % beträgt, kann in der Regel regranuliert und wiederverwendet werden. In unserer Berechnung wird dieser Anteil jedoch vollständig als Produktionsabfall berücksichtigt. 

Die Leiterplatten werden in Einsiedeln hergestellt. Am Schweizer Standort in Einsiedeln werden die Leiterplatten im THT- und SMD-Verfahren mit elektronischen Bauteilen bestückt. 

Die in Mölkau und Einsiedeln gefertigten Vorprodukte werden zusammen mit weiteren zugekauften Vorprodukten in Curtea de Argeș montiert und verpackt und anschließend in das Versandlager nach Herzebrock-Clarholz transportiert. 

Steinel hat den Strom-, Gas-, Öl- und Wasserverbrauch pro Produkt für die einzelnen Standorte ermittelt, indem der Jahresverbrauch durch die Produktionsmenge geteilt wurde. Die vom Unternehmen erhobenen Aktivitätsdaten beziehen sich auf das Jahr 2023.

technologicalApplicability.value: Presence detectors are devices installed in buildings that are used to control, monitor and set up the lighting system. They enable automatic changes and scenario settings.

Präsenzmelder sind Geräte, die in Gebäuden installiert werden und zur Steuerung, Überwachung und Einrichtung des Beleuchtungssystems dienen. Sie ermöglichen automatische Änderungen und Szenarieneinstellungen.
